headword: {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}
reading: ちゅうとうきょういく

definitions.gloss: the middle stage of formal schooling that sits between primary and higher education, generally corresponding to junior high school and high school; secondary education
definitions.explanation: The level of formal education between elementary school and university. In the Japanese system, {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく} covers {中学校|ちゅうがっこう} (junior high school, ages 12-15) and {高等学校|こうとうがっこう} (senior high school, ages 15-18). There are also combined {中等教育学校|ちゅうとうきょういくがっこう} that run for six years and teach both stages as one program. The term is used mainly in official education policy documents, statistics, and academic writing; in everyday life people talk about {中学校|ちゅうがっこう} or {高校|こうこう} directly.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{中等|ちゅうとう}→中等：22279_chuutou⟧ (middle level, intermediate) + ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧ (education). Part of a three-part set of terms that divide formal schooling by level: ⟦{初等|しょとう}→初等：16905_shotou⟧ (primary) → ⟦{中等|ちゅうとう}→中等：22279_chuutou⟧ (secondary) → ⟦{高等|こうとう}→高等：04184_koutou⟧ (higher / tertiary).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive secondary education
- {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}{学校|がっこう}: combined secondary school (6-year junior+senior high)
- {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}{機関|きかん}: secondary education institution
- {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧: the secondary education stage
- {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{課程|かてい}→課程：02653_katei⟧: the secondary education curriculum

THE THREE STAGES OF EDUCATION:
- ⟦{初等教育|しょとうきょういく}→初等教育：16629_shotoukyouiku⟧: primary education — elementary school (⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧), grades 1-6.
- {中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}: secondary education — junior high (⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧) + senior high (⟦{高等学校|こうとうがっこう}→高等学校：02997_koutougakkou⟧), grades 7-12.
- ⟦{高等教育|こうとうきょういく}→高等教育：19604_koutoukyouiku⟧: higher / tertiary education — university (⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧), graduate school (⟦{大学院|だいがくいん}→大学院：04783_daigakuin⟧), junior college, etc.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{義務教育|ぎむきょういく}→義務教育：13964_gimukyouiku⟧: compulsory education — in Japan, this covers elementary school plus lower secondary (⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧), i.e. nine years total. Upper secondary (⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧) is not legally compulsory but is attended by almost all students.
- ⟦{前期|ぜんき}→前期：20651_zenki⟧{中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}: lower secondary education (⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧).
- ⟦{後期|こうき}→後期：12603_kouki⟧{中等教育|ちゅうとうきょういく}: upper secondary education (⟦{高等学校|こうとうがっこう}→高等学校：02997_koutougakkou⟧).

REGISTER:
Formal and academic. Almost exclusively used in government documents, education policy discussions, research papers, and comparative international education statistics. In ordinary conversation, Japanese speakers simply say ⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧ and ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧.
